🔇 No sound?
  1. Turn off silent mode (the switch or Action button on the side of your iPhone) and turn the volume up.
  2. If you are viewing this inside an app preview, open the page in Safari (or Chrome on Android) instead.
  3. Check that a Dutch voice is installed: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices → Dutch.
